functional_decoder.parallelization_scope: single-device functional stage; P150x2/P150x4 collectives are deferred to multichip-decoder

multichip_decoder.parallelism: 1D tensor parallelism on mesh axis 1 with a replicated logical BF16 residual boundary: L1-interleaved for decode and DRAM-interleaved for prefill; OptimizedDecoder is the exact TP=1 baseline

kv_cache.layout: paged local KV heads per TP rank

tensor_plan.tp4_attention_collective: reduce physical width 2944 as 736 columns per rank, then slice to logical 2880
tensor_plan.expert_collective: reduce logical width 2880; measured runtime padding to 2944 was 1.7799x slower

optimized_decode_contract.inter_layer_residual: logical [1,1,batch,2880] BF16, replicated across ranks, L1 interleaved; producer-owned and consumer-borrowed
optimized_decode_contract.decode_norm: 10-core L1 width-sharded RMSNorm for both norms
optimized_decode_contract.attention_math_fidelity: decode projections LoFi; prefill packed QKV HiFi2 and output projection LoFi
optimized_decode_contract.prefill_attention_ccl_dtype_at_tested_le: bfloat16; inherited prefill fused reduce-scatter plus all-gather path, outside the custom decode-tail CCL dtype sweep
optimized_decode_contract.expert_geometry: gate/up 45 cores with in0_block_w=30 and TP2/TP4 subblock 1x2/1x1; decode down 15 cores with subblock 1x6; prefill down 45 cores with subblock 1x2
optimized_decode_contract.tp2_decode_output_projection: 16-core DRAM-width-sharded BFP8 weight; physical output 3072, internally sliced to logical 2880
optimized_decode_contract.tp4_decode_output_projection: native L1 path at physical output 2944, internally sliced to logical 2880

validation.trace_allocation_tracking: not enabled in this stage; replay release ordering is exercised by batch-1 stress and batch-2 cache/refresh tests
validation.watcher_scope: fully enabled TT_METAL_WATCHER=10 with TT_METAL_FABRIC_OPT_LEVEL=Os passed TP2/TP4 sliding/full in one process, including fabric stop/reopen and clean final teardown; ordinary active-fabric 1000x3 stress also clean

optimization_persistent_memory.context_effect: none; KV dtype/layout and configured/supported decoder context remain unchanged

multichip_decoder.full_stack_capacity_note: Physical TT tile accounting is a lower bound before embeddings, LM head, allocator fragmentation, CCL, trace, and activation buffers. TP=1 and TP=2 do not fit a resident 36-layer 120B stack plus batch-1 full-context KV in 32 GiB/device. TP=4 does; the later full-model stage must measure its exact non-decoder allocations and largest feasible batch. The decoder-layer API does not reduce the 131072-token model contract.
limitations: TP2 fused matmul-reduce-scatter hangs on this Blackhole runtime for both padded-3072 and native-2880 adapted contracts; the faster complete-layer default uses a separate projection and physical-width ring reduction
P150 and P150x2 do not fit the estimated resident 36-layer decoder weights plus batch-1 full-context KV cache in 32 GiB per device
Full-model and vLLM assembly are outside this stage

capacity_reduction.P150: resident 36-layer weights, terminal tensors, batch-1 full-context KV/page state, and a 2 GiB trace/activation reserve require 74895259776 bytes/device (69.751646 GiB); fixed state already exceeds 32 GiB so the largest feasible context is 0
capacity_reduction.P150x2: resident 36-layer weights, terminal tensors, batch-1 full-context KV/page state, and a 2 GiB trace/activation reserve require 39272108928 bytes/device (36.575002 GiB); fixed state already exceeds 32 GiB so the largest feasible context is 0

sampling.default: canonical traced split sampling via models.common.sampling.SamplingGenerator
sampling.greedy: device top-k=1/top-p=0 semantic argmax with tt_out_tok feedback

batch2_full_logit_reproducibility.recovery_note: an initial source-unchanged failure with stable HF-matching greedy tokens cleared after a bounded physical device reset; the unchanged exact gate then passed twice
